thesis: Ben Horowitz argues that the United States must win the next technological revolution in AI to ensure global advancement, as its system is irreplaceable because it provides a unique chance for people to contribute and advance humanity. He contends that American freedoms, rooted in self-evident truths rather than human invention, are uniquely protected and persistent, making the American model essential for the world. Horowitz highlights that while China previously led in integrating AI with government and military systems, the U.S. is catching up rapidly due to strong entrepreneurial support and government interest in advanced technologies.
